parties.petitioner: The Secretary To Government Department of Health & Family Welfare & Anr.

summary: Seniority upon cadre change due to medical grounds; request-based transfer vs public interest; Karnataka Civil Services Rules, 1977 Rule 16(iii) applicable; consent to junior seniority binding; Tribunal and HC precedent distinguished; seniority below last candidate upheld; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977 Rule 16
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; seniority of respondent to be determined from 1989 cadre change, not 1979 appointment; dismissal of Original Application restored.
